# Schemeofwork.com

> A comprehensive Nigerian educational resource platform providing curriculum guides, scheme of work documents, and teaching materials for primary and secondary schools across Nigeria's states.

Schemeofwork.com serves as a centralized hub for Nigerian educators and school administrators seeking standardized curriculum resources aligned with NERDC guidelines. The platform aggregates scheme of work materials, subject syllabi, and academic planning tools for schools across Nigeria's regions including Lagos State, Delta State, and the Federal Capital Territory.

## Key Topics

- Scheme of Work
- Nigerian Educational Curriculum
- Primary Education
- Secondary Education
- NERDC (Nigerian Educational Research and Development Council)
- Subject Syllabi
- Teaching Resources
- Academic Planning
- Lagos State Schools
- Delta State Schools
- Federal Capital Territory Schools
- Hausa Language
- Educational Standards
